what: Over a two-line title pinned at screen center, a photo frame pinned in the same spot starts floating at .5x 75vh below, then bound to scroll it grows into place and to full screen (1x), while the inner photo shrinks from 1.8x to 1x so the inside of the frame feels pulled in. During the first third of the range, the top line scatters left −20% and the bottom line right 20% while fading out (no curve). Title words can light up one by one (.1) at the start of the range

options.start: Start growing — ScrollTrigger start, default top top
options.end: Fully grown — ScrollTrigger end, default bottom bottom
options.lift: Distance the photo frame starts lowered, default 75vh
options.spread: Distance the two lines scatter (%), default 20
options.[data-fx-part=line]: Lines to scatter (first goes left, second goes right)

use: Top row,Bottom line.

from.where: pages.js .co-config — original racket-configurator (trigger: previous section bottom top−=100px → card board top top · top-line xPercent −20 · bottom-line 20 · autoAlpha 0 · .33 / background-image from y 75vh scale .5 · inner scale 1.8 · all ease none)

note: The element must be taller than the screen to pin (the original is about 250vh). The title and photo cell are position sticky, so they hold up inside an inner scroll pane too
